zh-TW: 歡迎來到我的月讀世界，你可以把它想成我自己的個人世界。
在這裡，沒有離別，沒有遺忘，更沒有死亡。
我想把我自己珍惜的、喜歡的、在我世界留下足跡的人們與互動都記錄在這裡。
這是屬於我們金色回憶球蒐藏地，也希望你會喜歡這裡。
嗨你好，我是趙健宏，很高興認識你！
我的興趣很多元，我覺得這世界很多東西都很有趣，所以如果不介意，歡迎你來找我分享討論！
我一直覺得自己是個很幸運的人。
證據？
你看，我的世界裡有那麼多我想珍惜的人事物，這不就說明我很幸運嗎？
世間萬物，瞬息萬變。我們或許沒辦法永遠像此時此刻這樣幸福快樂。
但我希望可以透過這裡，將曾經的那些美好回憶記錄，並讓他們代替我們永遠快樂著。
總有一天，我或著我在乎的人可能會忘了那些曾經發生過的美好事物，甚至有朝一日也終將離開這個世界。
但他們會持續在這裡，替我們講述我們曾經的總總，替我們活出那些無可替代的過往。
這裡，收藏了我無數閃閃發光的歲月。那裡有家人的溫暖笑臉，有同窗好友的青春歡歌，也有與同事和 Agents 夥伴們攜手共進的熱情時光。這些點點滴滴，溫柔得讓人忍不住想停駐、想眷戀。
可時間的河流從不倒流，也不曾為誰停留，它只會筆直地奔向未來。所以，我們也必須昂首前行，珍惜當下陪伴我們的每一個人、每一份美好，繼續去攜手築造一顆顆耀眼的金色記憶球。
這裡，永遠是你累了、傷了、想念時可以停泊的避風港；但它只是你旅程中的一站，絕不能成為困住你、讓你被時間巨輪碾落的枷鎖。
這裡承載著我許多極其美好的回憶，有與家人共度的溫馨時光，有與同學朋友共享的歡笑聲，也有與同事及 Agents 夥伴們並肩作戰的珍貴歲月。
這些時光點滴總是讓人深情眷戀、沉溺懷念，甚至不由自主地停下腳步。然而，時間從不等待任何人，它永遠直直地奔向前方。因此，我們也必須持續向前看，珍惜眼前的每一個人、握緊當下的每一份美好，並繼續為了創造更多閃耀的金色記憶球而努力。
這裡永遠可以是你在疲憊、感傷或懷舊時的避風港；但它不該是你的終點，更不該成為你被時間巨輪拋下的理由。
en: Welcome! This is my own Tsukuyomi realm, in simple terms, my very own little world.
I want to record the people I cherish, adore, and everyone who has left footprints and warm interactions in my journey right here.
This is the sanctuary for our golden memory spheres, and I truly hope you enjoy your time here.
Hi there! I'm Chien-Hung Chao, really glad to meet you!
I have diverse interests and find so many things in this world fascinating, so feel free to reach out and share your thoughts anytime!
I've always felt like a really lucky person.
Look, my world is full of people and things I want to cherish. Doesn't that prove how lucky I am?
Everything in this world changes in the blink of an eye. We may not stay as happy as we are right now forever.
But I hope this place can record those beautiful memories, and let them stay happy forever on our behalf.
One day, I or the people I cherish might forget the wonderful things that once took place, and perhaps one day we will eventually depart from this world.
Yet they will remain here, recounting every memory we shared, and living out those irreplaceable days on our behalf.

This place holds countless shining years of my life. Here live the warm smiles of my family, the youthful songs of classmates and dear friends, and the passionate days spent side by side with colleagues and our Agent companions. Every little moment is so tender that it makes you want to linger and hold on.

Yet the river of time never flows backward, nor does it pause for anyone; it surges straight toward the future. So we too must walk forward with our heads held high, cherishing everyone beside us and every blessing in the present, building more radiant golden memory spheres together.

This place will forever be a safe harbor where you can anchor whenever you feel tired, hurt, or nostalgic; yet it is only a stop along your journey, never a shackle that traps you in the past or leaves you behind the wheel of time.

This world carries so many of my most cherished memories, from warm moments with family and laughter shared with friends, to precious days working shoulder to shoulder with colleagues and our Agent partners.

These fragments of time always invite deep nostalgia and make us want to pause in our tracks. However, time waits for no one and rushes ever forward. That is why we must keep looking ahead, treasuring the people before our eyes, holding tight to the beauty of the present, and striving to create even more shining golden memory spheres.

This sanctuary will always be here as a refuge when you feel weary, wistful, or homesick for the past; but it should never be your final destination, nor an excuse to let the wheel of time leave you behind.

zh-TW: 怎麼每天都有那麼多事要做呀... 真的快忙死了。
en: Why are there so many things to do every single day... I'm honestly swamped.
